title: TRICARE Select as Second Payer on Corrected Outpatient Lines
content:
**Provision.** What TRICARE would pay as primary payer on a corrected **TRICARE Select** outpatient line is the allowed amount times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability, never below zero. With other health insurance on file, the deductible and cost share of a corrected outpatient line are figured on the allowed amount net of the other insurer's payment, and where the other insurer paid on it TRICARE pays second: where the provider is non-network nonparticipating, TRICARE pays the lesser of what it would pay as primary payer and the charge the provider may bill the beneficiary (the billed amount, never more than the allowed amount plus the tier's balance-billing limit percentage) less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability; where the provider is participating, TRICARE pays the allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability; otherwise TRICARE pays what it would pay as primary payer. Each figure is rounded to the cent and never below zero.

The billed amount, the allowed amount, the other insurer's payment and the provider's network relationship are those recorded on the reversed line. The balance-billing limit is 15 percent on every TRICARE Select tier (TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A and Group B tiers, Retiree Group A and Retiree Group B alike).

## Who pays how

| Other health insurance on file and other insurer paid on the line | Provider | TRICARE payment |
|---|---|---|
| yes | non-network nonparticipating | the lesser of the primary-payer amount and: the billed amount (capped at the allowed amount plus 15 percent) less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the liability |
| yes | participating (network, or non-network accepting assignment) | the allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the liability |
| no | any | the primary-payer amount |

## Hypothetical lines (attending share one, liability 20.00, allowed amount 200.00)

- Participating provider, other insurer paid 150.00: 200.00 less 150.00 is 50.00, less 20.00: 30.00.
- Nonparticipating provider billed 260.00, other insurer paid 150.00: the billed amount is capped at 230.00 (200.00 plus 15 percent); 230.00 less 150.00 is 80.00, less 20.00 is 60.00; the primary-payer amount is 180.00; TRICARE pays the lesser, 60.00.
- No other insurer payment: TRICARE pays the primary-payer amount, 180.00.
